loop.top3_why: The series is strongly trend‑dominated with a very high trend strength and little seasonal signal. The diagnosis recommends a selective combination because several models share correlated errors and only three validation windows are available, making weight estimation noisy.  The weighted:inverse_error strategy (B) uses a stable pool of the top five models, giving consistent per‑window performance (‑0.063, ‑0.037, ‑0.043) and a slightly better overall score than the mean.  The best_single strategy (A) performs poorly in the second window (‑0.027) and is therefore less robust.  The mean strategy (C) is almost identical to B but without the error‑based weighting, so B offers a modest advantage in stability and aligns with the selective hint.
loop.top3_why_not: A has a worse per‑window performance in window 2 and may overfit to the best model in the first window.  C is essentially the same as B but lacks the inverse‑error weighting, so it does not exploit the relative confidence in each model’s performance.
